description: Read answers to an ask you posted, including approved answers and their supporting evidence. On a private ask, the first call may return a link for the person to open and tap Allow (it lets you read that ask's answers for a day); give them the link, then call again.

network.description: Which deployment: `mainnet` is the real network (real money); `testnet` is the sandbox (play money, a dry run).

wait_seconds.description: Block up to this long (max 45) waiting for a decision. Default 0. Call again to keep waiting.

name: collect_answer
title: Collect approved answers
